description: Stage D: node failures. Switch power-off (all own interfaces admin-down; neighbours lose carrier) and silent data-plane black hole (OVS fail-mode secure, flows deleted; all interfaces stay up) for DSW-1, SW-ADM, SW-COM at 0 and 5 Mb/s; host power-off (host interface admin-down) for all four hosts at 5 Mb/s (traffic matters for PC-SHOP sender / SRV-LOCAL receiver). 3 independent repetitions.
